title: Decision-Focused Learning via Neural Optimization Layers for Battery-Assisted Grid-Import Smoothing in AI Data Centers
abstract: arXiv:2611.13694v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rapid AI data-center power fluctuations challenge grid integration. Sustained grid-import smoothing requires allocating limited battery power and energy under uncertain demand. We formulate risk-aware BESS scheduling that coordinates advance reserve commitments and demand-responsive dispatch, accounting for operating costs, grid-ramp penalties, and their conditional value-at-risk. We develop battery scheduling decision-focused learning (BS-DFL) with a constraint-aware neural optimization layer trained directly from this objective without optimal-solution labels. The trained layer is then frozen to guide demand-predictor learning through scheduling costs and ramping risk, enabling solver-free rolling-horizon scheduling. In a 10,000-minute simulation using loads derived from measured AI workloads, BS-DFL reduces mean absolute minute-to-minute grid-import changes by 71.70% and total scheduling cost by 18.01% relative to an MSE-trained pre

translated_title: 基于神经优化层的决策聚焦学习：用于AI数据中心电池辅助电网购电平滑
translated_abstract: 快速的AI数据中心功率波动给电网接入带来了挑战。要实现持续的电网购电平滑，需要在不确定的需求下对有限的电池功率和能量进行分配。我们提出了一种风险感知的电池储能系统（BESS）调度方法，该方法协调事前备用容量承诺与需求响应式调度，同时考虑运行成本、电网爬坡惩罚及其条件风险价值（CVaR）。我们开发了电池调度决策聚焦学习（BS-DFL），其中包含一个约束感知的神经优化层，该层直接从调度目标进行训练，无需最优解标签。训练完成后，该神经优化层被冻结，通过调度成本和爬坡风险来引导需求预测器的学习，从而实现无需求解器的滚动时域调度。在使用基于实测AI工作负载推导的负荷进行的10,000分钟仿真中，与基于MSE训练的预测器相比，BS-DFL将电网购电的分钟级平均绝对变化降低了71.70%，并将总调度成本降低了18.01%。
tldr: 本文提出电池调度决策聚焦学习方法（BS-DFL），通过约束感知神经优化层将电池储能调度与需求预测端到端联合训练，无需最优解标签，在AI数据中心仿真中将电网购电分钟级波动降低71.70%、调度成本降低18.01%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes battery scheduling decision-focused learning (BS-DFL), which jointly trains demand prediction and battery storage scheduling through a constraint-aware neural optimization layer without optimal-solution labels, reducing minute-to-minute grid-import fluctuations by 71.70% and scheduling costs by 18.01% for AI data centers.
